[P2] Keep concurrency budgets separate for concurrent runs

Calls sharing a scheduler overwrite the same `_concurrency` value and share `_active`. Starting another run with a larger limit can admit additional cases from an existing serial run; a smaller limit can block otherwise admissible work until lease timeouts, even on independent targets. Sharing a scheduler across runs is explicitly supported by the ownership leases and tests. Key the concurrency limit and active count by run identity while preserving atomic acquisition with target capacity, and test overlapping runs with different limits.
